$comment: Provisional canonical identifier and provisional crypto shape. This is a discovery-level capability, not a copy of any particular key-server data model. Formats, encoding, revocation, and external key references are expected to evolve.
title: Crypto capability
description: Cryptographic material and hints for a mailbox. Encryption and signature verification are distinct semantic roles. A mailbox MAY omit this capability entirely, publish only one role, or publish empty key lists. Families MAY include OpenPGP, S/MIME (X.509), post-quantum schemes, and others; this schema does not exhaustively enumerate them.

encryption.description: Keys and hints intended for encrypting to this mailbox. Do not use these keys for signature verification unless a future family profile explicitly allows dual use.

verification.description: Not projected on the public Discovery Document. Verify material is fetched with GET /v1/keys purpose=verify, the unsalted mailbox sha256, and a key_id. Signing private keys are not a discovery capability. The vault OPRF identity is not this locator. Do not use verify keys for encryption unless a future family profile explicitly allows dual use.

key.description: A public key or a pointer toward one. Inline material and identifiers are optional so later revisions can emphasize external references. Encoding of publicKey is family-specific and not fully specified here.

family.description: Cryptographic family identifier. Examples (non-exhaustive, not a closed enum): openpgp, smime, x509, age, pq. Prefer lowercase tokens; future profiles may define a registry.

keyId.description: Publisher key identifier. SComm content-addressable signing ids are eight hex digits grouped as xxxx-xxxx (first 32 bits of SHA-256 over published public_material). Other publishers MAY use their own opaque ids (for example OpenPGP Key IDs).

publicKey.description: Optional inline public key material. Encoding is family-specific (for example an OpenPGP armored key or a certificate PEM). Prefer well-known encodings in later family profiles rather than inventing a new envelope here.

algorithms.description: Optional algorithm hints (family-specific tokens). Clients that do not recognize a token SHOULD ignore it.

uri.description: Optional locator for externally referenced key material. Fetching this URI is not specified in protocol 0.1-draft and has security and privacy implications.
